title: Stochastic Reconfiguration as Statistical Filtering for Overparameterized Neural Quantum States
abstract: arXiv:2609.23334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stochastic reconfiguration (SR) is the standard optimizer for neural quantum states (NQS), but modern NQS often have far more parameters than Monte Carlo samples. We show that in this regime the diagonal shift is more than a numerical stabilizer. It acts as a statistical filter for finite-sample generalization. At a fixed wave function, SR is ridge regression from tangent features to the centered local energy. Its residual is the expressivity gap, the part of imaginary-time evolution outside the current tangent space. This gap is orthogonal to the tangent space in population, but finite batches make it act as noise that SR can overfit. The shift therefore balances shrinkage of useful update directions against variance from fitting sampled residuals. translated_title: 随机重构作为过参数化神经量子态的统计滤波
translated_abstract: 随机重构（SR）是神经量子态（NQS）的标准优化器，但现代神经量子态的参数量往往远多于蒙特卡洛样本数。我们证明，在这种过参数化情形下，对角位移不仅仅是一个数值稳定器，它还充当一种用于有限样本泛化的统计滤波器。在固定波函数下，SR 等价于从切空间特征到中心化局部能量的岭回归。其残差即为表达能力差距，也就是虚时演化中超出当前切空间的部分。该差距在总体意义上与切空间正交，但有限批次会使其表现为 SR 可能过拟合的噪声。因此，位移在有用更新方向的收缩与拟合采样残差带来的方差之间取得平衡。在 4×4 海森堡图上的精确诊断将过参数化的两种效应区分开来：更大的切空间在能缩小表达能力差距时会有帮助，但当……时反而可能有害（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示了随机重构（SR）中的对角位移在过参数化神经量子态中实质上充当统计滤波器，通过在岭回归框架下平衡有用更新方向的收缩与拟合采样残差噪声的方差，来实现有限样本下的良好泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the diagonal shift in stochastic reconfiguration acts as a statistical filter for finite-sample generalization in overparameterized neural quantum states, balancing shrinkage of useful update directions against variance from fitting sampled residuals within a ridge regression framework.
